observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Tinmo 18-inch solar fan.
The box identifies the model as TM-72.
Specifications printed on the box include 7.4V voltage, 10W rated power, and a 12W solar panel.
The box art displays a pedestal fan, a remote control, a solar panel, and two LED bulbs.
The actual item is not visible outside of the packaging.
The box shows minor wear at the edges and corners.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different/damaged item.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual fan and all accessories outside the box.

risks.risk: The internal rechargeable battery may be degraded or dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on battery power for several minutes.

risks.risk: The solar panel or charging circuit may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the charging indicator active when the solar panel is connected in sunlight.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual fan, solar panel, remote, and bulbs outside the box.
A video of the fan operating on battery power.
A photo of the rating plate on the back of the fan motor or base.
A photo of the solar panel surface to check for cracks.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown. The actual condition, presence, and functionality of the fan and its accessories cannot be determined without seeing the items themselves.
